business_problem: In the face of rapidly evolving consumer demands and the constant push towards digital transformation, Asahi Europe & International recognized the need to keep its workforce updated with technology. This spurred AEI to adopt Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 E3.
solution_summary: Asahi Europe & International (AEI), a leading brewer, ushers in a new era of enhanced productivity and innovation by adopting Microsoft Copilot. In the face of rapidly evolving consumer demands and the constant push towards digital transformation, Asahi Europe & International recognized the need to keep its workforce updated with technology. This spurred AEI to adopt Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 E3. Asahi Europe & International is the international branch of Asahi Group Holdings, which is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Japan. AEI also set up a prompt "tap" on Microsoft Teams where employees could share Copilot-related knowledge among each other.
